# Payhawk → Google Drive receipt sync

The Apify actor [`apify/payhawk-google-drive-receipt-sync`](https://apify.com/apify/payhawk-google-drive-receipt-sync) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.6**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Automatically archive Payhawk expense receipts (PDFs) to a Google Drive folder. Incremental, idempotent, schedule-friendly — every new receipt lands in Drive without duplicates.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/payhawk-google-drive-receipt-sync) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-payhawk-google-drive-receipt-sync@0.0.6#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      payhawkApiKey: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `payhawkApiKey` | string | yes |  | Payhawk API key — API key used to authenticate against the Payhawk API. Create it in Payhawk under Settings → Integrations → API. |
| `payhawkAccountId` | string | yes |  | Payhawk account ID — Your Payhawk account ID — the `accountId` path segment shown alongside the API key. |
| `googleServiceAccount` | object | yes |  | Google service account JSON — Service account credentials JSON. The service account email must be added as a Content manager of the target Shared Drive (service accounts cannot upload to a personal My Drive). |
| `driveFolderId` | string | yes |  | Google Drive folder ID — ID of the destination folder inside a Shared Drive. It's the trailing segment of the folder URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/. |
| `exportedInto` | string |  | `"Google Drive"` | Exported-into label — Value written to Payhawk's export history `exportedInto` field — visible in the Payhawk UI to indicate where the receipt was sent. Override for testing (e.g. 'Test sync') before switching to your production label. |
| `syncLagDays` | integer |  | `0` | Sync lag (days) — Only sync expenses created at least this many days ago. This gives your team time to attach or correct a receipt before it is synced to Drive. Defaults to 0 (sync immediately with no lag); set e.g. 7 to wait a week. |
| `onlyApproved` | boolean |  | `true` | Only approved expenses — When enabled (the default), only expenses that have been approved in Payhawk's approval workflow are synced. Expenses still waiting for approval are left untouched and re-checked on the next run, so they sync as soon as they are approved. Turn this off if your account has no |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | `false` | Dry run — When enabled, the Actor lists expenses and downloads receipts but does NOT upload to Drive or write back to Payhawk. Use for the first test run. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
